about_the_game:
Backfire Brigade is a chaotic and action-packed couch co-op firefighting game designed for two to four players. Grab your gear, rally your team, and dive into intense rescue missions where every second counts. Whether you're dousing flames or hauling victims to safety, teamwork is key to surviving the blaze.

Features:

  • Chaotic Couch Co-op – Play locally with friends in frantic, fire-filled action where coordination can mean the difference between victory and going up in smoke.

  • Simple Controls for Everyone – Easy-to-learn mechanics ensure anyone can pick up a controller and join the fun.

  • Unlockable Environments – Progress through a variety of dangerous scenarios, from small suburban homes to sprawling forest fires.

  • Adjustable Difficulty – Use gameplay modifiers to tailor each mission, adding new challenges or easing the chaos to match your crew's style.

  • Rescue & Extinguish – Balance your priorities between saving trapped victims and battling growing infernos before everything collapses.

Grab your helmet, hose, and a sense of humor—because when the flames rise and chaos takes hold, only the Backfire Brigade can save the day!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WIN10 or later
  • Processor: 3 GHz Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Backfire Brigade is a chaotic couch co-op firefighting game for two to four players. Coordinate with your fellow firefighters to rescue victims trapped in burning buildings while extinguishing the flames.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Swedish
